meta.notes: Google Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 via Mammouth AI (EU). Google's model page (ai.google.dev, gemini-nano-banana-2.1) names it an update to Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image), latest update October 2026. Mammouth is the route: the platform's OpenRouter connection uses OpenRouter's EU host, whose catalogue held no image model on 2026-10-18, and OpenRouter serves this model through Google AI Studio only. Requires a Mammouth AI key (MAMMOUTH_API_KEY or devserver/mammouth.key).
